notes: The registry record hasResults=false and no resultsSection; no posted outcomeMeasuresModule or adverseEventsModule is available. The abstract reports serious adverse reactions (1/16 hydrocortisone vs 0/14 placebo), the closest printed outcome to the requested Serious adverse events. These are reactions, not an explicitly reported all-serious-adverse-events total. The registry protocol defines the reaction outcome as participants with one or more new episodes of septic shock, invasive fungal infection, clinically important GI bleeding or anaphylactic reaction, at day 14. The abstract does not separately specify the reaction assessment timepoint. Mortality 6/16 vs 2/14 is a different outcome and was not selected.
